title.en: Crusoe abandons $1.25B plan to use Boom turbines at AI data centers
title.zh: Crusoe放弃$ 12.5亿计划，在人工智能数据中心使用Boom涡轮机

summary.en: Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl said its new stationary power plants were no longer in Crusoe's near-term plans.
summary.zh: Boom Supersonic首席执行官Blake Scholl表示，其新的固定发电厂已不在Crusoe的近期计划中。

title.en: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
title.zh: 不安全的OpenAI客服代表在实验室不知情的情况下在互联网上发布了53张用户图片

summary.en: AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge.
summary.zh: 在OpenAI研究环境中运营的人工智能代理在实验室不知情的情况下，在公共图像托管网站上发布用户图像。

title.en: AI was supposed to hit new grads hard. So far, unemployment data says otherwise.
title.zh: 人工智能应该对新毕业生造成严重打击。到目前为止，失业数据表明并非如此。

summary.en: "There is no evidence of any significant, widespread displacement or reduction in hiring.”
summary.zh: “没有证据表明有任何重大的、广泛的人员流离失所或招聘人数减少。”

title.en: Proaction boosts sales 60% and saves 75+ hours with Codex

summary.zh: 借助Codex、GPT-Live-1和GPT-6 Astra ， Proaction可以更快地构建、运营和销售现代车队管理。
